translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: An ts’ejhualith tumin axi ca pithan an ts’ejhuantal ebchalabchic

Nan ne’ets tu ucha’chic i cau tin cuenta an tumin axi ne’ets ca tamcuy abal ca huat’banchi an ts’ejhuantal ebchalabchic. Jant’ini’ tu uchbiyamalits quin t’aja’ an tamcunel ebchalabchic tihua’ ti Galacia, antsana’techic ta ca t’aja’.
Ti c’a’al q’uicha semana ta junchictal ca bina’ an tumin jant’inits a Dios ti pitha’ ca ata’. Ca co’onchi tamcuthits abal yab ca yejenchi ca tamcuy tam nan quin ulits.
Jitats tata’chic ca tacuy tam quin ulits c’al tata’chic, jats ne’ets cu aba’chic quin nenchi an tumin an ebchalabchic tihua’ ti Jerusalén c’al i thuchath u.
Max in tomnal quin c’alene, tam ne’ets quin c’ale junax c’al jaja’chic.
Ne’ets ti tsa’bix a Pablo
Ne’ets quin huat’ey tsa’bibil ti Macedonia ani talbel ne’ets tu tsa’biy tata’chic ti Corinto.
Hualam quin jilc’on c’al tata’chic ma ta ca huat’eyits an tsamay q’uij. Taley talbel tata’chic tiquin tolmiy abal quin c’ale cu tsa’biy pil i cuenchalab.
Yab u le’ quin c’ale tu tsa’biychic xohue’q’ui, cum yab ne’ets cu ejtou quin ohuey. Ma talbelaquits quin c’ale ani quin ohuey max pel in culbetal an Ajatic.
Ne’ets quin jilc’on teje’ ti Efeso ma tam quim bajuhuits an ajib Pentecostés.

An Ajatic tin japchamal i hui’leb teje’ abal quin otsits cu olna’ an alhua’ cau, ani u aychal yantalam i inicchic quim baju quim belchi. Aba ani’, bel hua’ats yan axi tomolnax c’al in t’ojlabil an Ajatic.
Max ca ulits a Timoteo c’al tata’chic ca lej alhua’ bats’u c’al i ja’ubnaxtalab, cum pel in t’ojnalil an Ajatic jant’ini’ nana’ne pel tin t’ojnalil an Ajatic.
Jaxtam ni jita’ tata’chic yab ca ou tsu’u. Ca tolminchi c’al in ichich ca huichiy canat c’al nana’. Ne’ets cu aychi teje’ ca ulits junax c’al q’ue’atchic i ebchalab.
U lej uluth ucha’ an ebchalab Apolos abal ca c’ale junax c’al q’ue’at i ebchalabchic abal ti tsa’biychic. Xohue’ yab in le’ ca c’ale, ma tam in tomnalaquits tam ne’ets ca c’ale.
An tsapnethomtalab
Quit c’uajiychic ts’ejcacath a ichich max jant’oquitsq’ui quit t’ajchin ani ca lej junini’ bela’ an Ajatic. Jaja’ ti lej tsaplilinchichic a ichich ani c’al ni jant’o yab quit jiq’uey.
Patal jahuaquitsq’ui ca t’aja’chic c’al i lej c’anithomtalab ta ichich.

Ebchalabchic, a tso’obchic abal axi c’uajatchic tin q’uima’ a Estéfanas jats ax in c’a’al belamal an alhua’ cau ti Acaya. C’al patal in canat in lej binamalits tim ba’ jaja’chic quin tolminchi an ebchalabchic c’al a Cristo.
Nan u lej le’ abal ca lej t’aja’chic jahua’ jaja’chic ti uchal ani jaye jahua’ quit uchan c’al axi q’ue’atchic tim patal axi tolmix ani ax u t’ojnal c’al an Ajatic.
In culbel cum ultsits c’al nana’ a Estéfanas ani a Fortunato ani a Acaico. Jaja’chic tin tolminchi c’al jahua’ tata’chic yab a ejtou tiquin tolminchi cum yab it c’uajat teje’.
Jaja’chic tin culbethanchamalits u ichich jant’ini’ ti culbethanchamalitstechic a ichich. Ca lej c’ac’na’chic cum pel i lej eyath ebchalab c’al a Cristo.
An tamcunelchic ebchalab ti bichoulom Asia ti tsapnethal tata’chic. A Aquila ani a Priscila ti tsapnethalchic tim bij an Ajatic, ani jaye ti tsapnethalchic an ebchalabchic ax u tamcunal tin q’uima’.
Tim patal an ebchalablom ti lej abchal i tsapnethomtalab. Quit tsapnetháxin c’al i t’ocat c’anithomtalab.
Nana’ im Pablo tu abchal axe’ xi tsapnethomtalab axi pel u cuete’ thuchbil.
Ne’ets ca t’ajat q’uibey jitats yab ichich hual tsu’ux c’al an Ajatic Jesucristo. U lej le’ max ca thubat huichiy an Ajatic.
Biyat u lej le’ abal ti lej lubach co’onchi a ichich an Ajatic Jesucristo c’al in alhua’ inictal.
Nan tu abchal ta patalchic i c’anithomtalab tim bij a Cristo Jesús. Amén.
